subject: Digital Electronics
learning_objective: Read MPP as saved privilege and demonstrate S→M trap entry followed by an MRET restoration of mode and interrupt-enable stack.
core_conclusion: Current privilege and saved MPP are different state: trap entry saves the old mode, and MRET consumes that saved mode.

terminology.scope: Privileged ISA1.13 mstatus stack. Example hart supports M/S/U; no delegation or hypervisor; initial S-mode, MIE=1 and MPP=U. ECALL from S has cause9. Access policies are configured to allow the shown handler and return.

scenes.timing_reason: Animate the causal object operation, then keep its numerical consequence legible for at least two seconds.
scenes.objects: Three privilege lanes U(00),S(01),M(11); active hart marker at S; mstatus.MPP=00; MIE=1; MPIE=0.
scenes.initial_state: The hart runs S-mode while the saved previous-mode field reads U.
scenes.trigger: Read current mode and saved MPP as two different quantities.
scenes.change: Place the active hart in S and unfold MPP bits00 in a separate CSR area. The two markers deliberately occupy different rows.
scenes.cause: Read current mode and saved MPP as two different quantities.
scenes.result: MPP is visibly not a display of current privilege.

scenes.timing_reason: Animate the causal object operation, then keep its numerical consequence legible for at least two seconds.
scenes.objects: Active S marker; MPP bits00; MIE=1/MPIE=0; S ECALL.
scenes.initial_state: S is current, MPP=00, MIE=1 and MPIE=0.
scenes.trigger: An undelegated S-mode ECALL enters M at8s.
scenes.change: Copy S code01 into MPP; shift MIE value1 into MPIE; set MIE=0; move the active hart marker up to M. Show cause9 beside the entry.
scenes.cause: An undelegated S-mode ECALL enters M at8s.
scenes.result: Current mode is M while MPP remains S(01); interrupt state was saved rather than lost.

scenes.timing_reason: Animate the causal object operation, then keep its numerical consequence legible for at least two seconds.
scenes.objects: MRET in M lane; MPP=01; MIE=0; MPIE=1; saved PC prepared by handler.
scenes.initial_state: The active hart is M but MPP still records S.
scenes.trigger: MRET executes at16s after the handler has selected its return PC.
scenes.change: Move the MPP01 token to the S lane and relocate the hart M→S; restore MIE from MPIE1; reset MPIE to1 and MPP to00, the least supported privilege.
scenes.cause: MRET executes at16s after the handler has selected its return PC.
scenes.result: The restored active mode S differs from the reset MPP U; restoration uses the old MPP, not its new reset value.
english_copy: MRET restores S from old MPP

scenes.timing_reason: Animate the causal object operation, then keep its numerical consequence legible for at least two seconds.
scenes.objects: Three snapshots: before trap / in handler / after MRET, containing active mode, MPP, MIE, MPIE.
scenes.initial_state: The completed round trip is S→M→S.
scenes.trigger: Lay out the actual saved states in event order.
scenes.change: Move snapshots into adjacent columns: (S,U,1,0), (M,S,0,1), (S,U,1,1). Trace the active marker path separately from the MPP values.
scenes.cause: Lay out the actual saved states in event order.
scenes.result: Two S-mode snapshots have MPP=U; the M-mode handler snapshot has MPP=S. State transfer explains the transitions.

critical_processes.uncertainty: MRET must choose S from pre-reset MPP01 before resetting MPP00; treating MPP as the active mode would incorrectly return to U.
critical_processes.expected_observation: On MRET active marker lands in S, MPP becomes U, MIE restores1 and MPIE becomes1.

risk_moments.reason: All entry stack values and mode change together.
Use pre-event MPP01 to choose S; reset MPP00 afterward in the same event.

design_audit.visualArgument: An active-hart token moves between privilege lanes while independent saved-state bit cells copy, restore and reset; their differing values disprove the common MPP=current-mode misconception.
design_audit.motion: Mode-token transfer plus discrete stack-field copies at trap and return.
design_audit.example: Undelegated S ECALL with MIE1 enters M and saves MPP01; MRET returns S while MPP resets00.
design_audit.antiTemplate: This is a privilege-state stack, not a PC-address timeline or generic trap flow. The decisive picture shows active S alongside saved U.
design_audit.sceneRationale: Four scenes suffice: distinguish active/saved state, save on entry, consume on return, and compare the three actual snapshots. More handler detail would obscure MPP.

title: Privilege Mode Transition: Save and Restore the Mode
prompt:
A 28-second silent English educational animation for a university digital electronics course on Privilege Mode Transition: distinguish the active hart in S-mode from saved MPP=00 for U-mode; move the hart to M on an undelegated trap while MPP becomes 01, MIE clears from 1 to 0, and MPIE receives 1; use the old saved S-mode during MRET to restore active S and MIE=1 while MPP resets to 00 and MPIE remains 1, then compare active S/M/S against saved U/S/U across the three snapshots.

Use a radial dark background from #142238 through #0d1626 to #070b12 with a 72px grid and a #60a5fa glow; primary #60a5fa marks main fields, registers, or paths, accent #fbbf24 marks carried values and selected quantities, result #34d399 marks completed values or valid selections, and warn #f87171 marks discarded or unavailable work; use Helvetica Neue with Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI, and sans-serif fallbacks, 50px headings at weight 700, 30px body copy, and 21px uppercase kickers with 5px tracking; at 30 fps, slide-up headings 22px over 16 frames from frame 8 and stagger-in copy from frame 24 in 12-frame steps with 12-frame fades and 16px rises; marker-travel carries saved-mode and interrupt-enable tokens over 45 frames; update active and saved state separately at frames 240 and 480 and stagger final state columns by 12 frames; provide the Remotion source and course kit with Remotion 4.0.410, React 19.0.0, TypeScript 5.8.2, Node.js, a Chromium render environment, and FFmpeg, with 1920x1080 H264 MP4 output and no audio; exact reproduction on a clean machine has not been verified.
